title: Kingdom Death combined review catalog
$comment: tsType annotations keep reviewed release labels open in generated types without relaxing stored-catalog validation.
description: Review export combining the app catalog, news product links, and collection workbook. IDs remain object keys. Monetary amounts use integer cents. Personal ownership is stored in imports/kdm-import-records.json.

announcements.description: Unique news publication dates, sorted chronologically.

colors.description: Color swatches in display order, paired by index with text labels when present.

editions.description: Selectable releases, ordered with Sim first and then chronologically by release date or release window; unknown dates last.

gameplay.description: Gameplay is false by default. Store this field only when true; editions may override it.

gameplayContent.description: Gameplay content supplied with this item. Release differences, when known, are described here.

handle.description: Shared Kingdom Death shop product handle. Applies to every edition; omit edition handles when present.

includes.description: Known included items, optionally qualified by their editions/materials and the containing release. Partial list; unspecified editions are not automatically owned.

kind.description: Product classification. The beta kind means all editions are Beta; box may contain mixed Beta and non-Beta editions or other boxed products. Bundles may omit kind.

price.description: Item price in cents for products without editions. Products with editions use the edition's prices array.

releaseDate.description: Release date for an item without selectable editions, YYYY-MM-DD.

releaseWindow.description: Imprecise release date for an item without selectable editions, such as a year or a year-first quarter.

releaseYear.description: Explicitly supplied product release year. Shirt and dice years are stored here rather than in editions; unknown years are omitted.

size.description: Default physical model size or scale (mm), retained as supplied text. Edition size overrides this value; Sim never inherits it. Omit unknown sizes.

tags.description: Reviewed descriptive tags from the master tag file.

text.description: Labels for color swatches in matching order. Repeated labels are allowed for distinct swatches.

url.description: External listing URL. Kingdom Death shop product listings use handle instead.

urls.description: Additional product URLs for an item without editions.

label.description: Selectable release label, such as First Run, Encore, Plastic, or Sim.

available.description: Available in at least one matching cached shop variant. False by default; omit when unavailable or unknown.

beta.description: Beta release. Omit for non-Beta editions.

gameplay.description: Override of the item gameplay default (false when omitted). Store only when different from the item default.

handle.description: Kingdom Death shop product handle. Used only when the item has no shared handle.

includesAllSim.description: Grants every current and future simulator edition. Resolve against editions marked simulator when reading the catalog; do not materialize a static list.

materials.description: Known materials of this release. Omitted means the material is unspecified.

name.description: Release-specific name when it differs from the sculpt item name, such as Plastic Ramette.

numbered.description: The release is known to have individually numbered copies. Omit otherwise.

items.description: Amount in cents; inherits the item currency, which defaults to USD.

prices.description: Known sale amounts plus current MSRP in cents. Maximum is MSRP; the array makes no active-sale claim. Price evidence and estimates remain in the audit.

releaseDate.description: Exact release date, YYYY-MM-DD. Derive its year from this value; use releaseWindow when only a year or an imprecise date is known.

releaseWindow.description: An imprecise release date, including a year alone such as 2024, a quarter in year-first format such as 2026 Q4, or a named source window. No exact date is invented.

runSize.description: Known production or sale limit. Omit unknown counts; preserve supplied First Run and Encore counts. Do not infer counts from units sold.

simulator.description: This digital release is a Kingdom Death Simulator entitlement. Omit for other releases, including 3D Files.

size.description: Physical release size override when it differs from the item default. Sim never has a model size. Omit unknown placeholders.

standalone.description: False when confirmed to be available only as part of another product. Omit for standalone or unconfirmed releases. Collection views may hide these editions.

url.description: External listing URL. Kingdom Death shop product listings use handle instead.

announcement.description: News publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. Full post details remain in kingdom-death-news/news-shop-links.json.

oneOf.description: Included catalog key. The source does not specify a particular edition; this does not mean every edition is included.

editionId.description: Stable selected edition ID on the included child item. Use separate references for separate child editions, qualified by parentEditionIds when needed.

parentEditionIds.description: Stable edition IDs on the containing item for which this inclusion applies. Omitted means no edition restriction on the containing item; physical contents still require a physical release.

oneOf.description: Included item restricted to a child edition ID or materials. Physical child editions require a physical containing edition; digital child editions require a digital containing edition. Optional parentEditionIds restricts membership to those containing editions. Never grant ownership of other editions.

editionId.description: Permanent readable release ID, unique within its item. Assign once; retain it when labels, names, or other facts change. The item and bundle IDs are reserved for synthetic editions.
